firstAttempt.direction: Use the business's own genuine photo as the base image, cropped to portrait 4:5 so the main subject sits in the lower two-thirds of the frame. Apply a soft vertical gradient from the top edge, fading from primary blue #74A7FE at roughly 45% opacity to transparent by mid-frame, with a faint warm #FFC677 tint in the lower right corner for contrast and warmth. Keep the upper third visually calm and uncluttered, with no detail competing with the headline area. Keep the lighting natural and the grading neutral and slightly warm, with no heavy filters, vignettes or glow. Use a clean sans-serif-friendly composition with generous negative space. Exclusions: no text, no logos, no stock people, no invented staff or patients, no medical imagery such as spine scans or x-rays, no exclamation-style graphics, no price tags, badges or star ratings, and no claims about what the photo shows.
